purpose: Application-side full scan for declared, exact relational operations. Traverse the entire available register, preserve whole source records and send only unique matches or the unique largest integer row. No expected source ID or answer amount may enter the logical query. Fail open to full data on ambiguous matches, malformed fields or tied maximum. No free-form query parsing or server policy change.
design: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct BF16 page-v1. Two new physical A100 server processes, fixed configuration, prefix retention off. Each case runs full and reduced input on the same GPU, alternating order by case and reversing between GPUs. Real streaming unconstrained JSON answer with same prompt on both inputs, no oracle values inserted. Start from ready complete tool JSON bytes and include parsing, reduction, serialization, HTTP and final answer emission.
gates: Require exact source data reconstruction and complete SSE. All eight reduced cases must recover correct source and amount on each GPU, including held-out seeds. No loss of previously correct answers. For every case on both GPUs require smaller input and at least 20% lower first and last content latency. Report lengths, dispatch cost and all errors. The model still has to read arbitrary unstructured tasks that have no typed relational operator.
